plan.name: Render explicit receipt literals faithfully
plan.summary: Render literals throughout explicit component receipts as escaped <code> elements, including fingerprints, ratified statement names and pins, bounds, toolchain versions, images and recipes, and literals in evidence rows and failure descriptions, escaping each original value before assembling markup so visible text is neither entity-encoded nor escaped twice. Preserve existing shortening of hashes and image digests, original report and JSON values, fingerprints, gate outcomes, component proof coverage and all legacy Markdown; hostile text must remain literal without creating HTML, links, table cells or rows, or proof statuses, and the existing component-table escaping tests remain unchanged. Update SPEC.md and README.md to describe this rendering fix and correct all remaining-work descriptions: #244 supplies the component evidence foundation and views for the narrowed step 1 of #210, steps 3 and 4 of #210 check unchanged Go and Python packages against a model, steps 6 and 7 prove selected Go and Python functions in place, each execution step connects the gate for its own path, and TypeScript discovery is outside that ordinary Go and Python scope. Retain the current execution limits: attribution runs no tools, explicit code verification remains rejected with verify.ErrComponents before tools run, model-only checking remains available, and explicit Python and TypeScript configurations remain rejected. Cite the supporting decisions on every changed SPEC bullet, using D-0013, D-0135, D-0152, D-0158, D-0161, D-0163 and D-0122 as applicable; this fix needs no new decision and leaves pinned statements, locks and decisions/ unchanged.

tests.name: TestExplicitReceiptLiteralVisibleText
tests.says: Explicit statement names, fingerprints, bounds and every toolchain value render as code with their original visible characters after one entity decode, including No_Double, image tags, literal entities and line endings, while JSON remains unchanged.

tests.name: TestExplicitReceiptEvidenceLiteralVisibleText
tests.says: Explicit evidence rows and failure descriptions render their names, actions, paths, hashes and states as code without escaped markup or double escaping, including values assembled into larger sentences.

tests.name: TestExplicitReceiptHostileLiteralsPreserveStructureAndLegacy
tests.says: Hostile text displays literally in code without adding HTML, links, table cells or rows or changing proof statuses; report values, JSON round trips, legacy Markdown and fingerprints remain unchanged.
